notes: S2-FIX2 U2 (decision 2026-11-15 #22; Q6, §5.5.2 step 1 in two tiers): a note cites the depth-10 grant of a chain of ten delegated grants, so its chain has ten links, two beyond the bound of 8; the parent at the tenth link, the root grant, is present but itself invalid (E_KEY_VALIDITY). Step 1, first tier, at every link: grant-depth-1 to grant-depth-10 are invalid E_GRANT_GRANTER (grant-depth-10's own chain also has more than eight links, which step 7 would make E_GRANT_UNRESOLVED), and so is the note. The invalid outcome beyond the bound is reported instead of the depth code, as the S2-FIX1 Q5 walk intends.
